correctness.rationale: For P_H the strict upper cone at x is x+H_+. If y<x, the least positive m in H gives y+m in Up(y) but not Up(x), so P_H^+(x,y) fails. For d=y-x>=0, upper-cone inclusion is equivalent to d+H_+ being contained in H_+, which holds precisely for d in H or for a pseudo-Frobenius gap. Pseudo-Frobenius adjunction remains a numerical semigroup, so induction gives the full iteration. Every nonterminal stage adds the Frobenius number; genus drops by exactly the current type, yielding finite termination, ell(H)<=g(H), and the telescoping genus identity.
